question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Bashful".
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Loquacious.** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Loquacious** means very talkative or tending to talk a great deal. The opposite of bashful, which implies being shy or reserved. (बातूनी) 
• **Example:** She was very loquacious and enjoyed chatting with everyone at the party. 
Therefore, the correct answer is: **Loquacious**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:
 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Tending not to talk very much. This is actually similar in meaning to bashful. 
• **Example:** He is a quiet person and does not talk much with strangers. 
• **Taciturn** (मौनी): Reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little. This is actually similar in meaning to bashful. 
• **Example:** She was taciturn during the meeting. 
• **Diffident** (संकोची): Modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence. This also has a similar meaning to bashful. 
• **Example:** He was diffident about his abilities.
